name: @r4-adapters/customer-http
description: R4-J4-R2 Customer Profile HTTP adapter of the CustomerProfilePort (MS-pesaschile-customer-profile customer-profile.sales-context; runtime pinned to v1-rc2 at owner commit bbd766e since R4-J4-R3, v1-rc1 at 47db415 kept as regression evidence): one POST route with the purpose fixed by the port operation, bearer auth plus the opaque CIA grant in x-customer-access-grant (R4-J4-R3), no redirects, deadline, UTF-8 byte cap, forbidden-field scan, allowlist projection validated against the pinned JSON Schema, customer_grant_verified required and validUntil bounded by the grant, lifecycle and freshness checks, typed owner errors. Transport only. Outside R4 Core.
